description: This file defines WebSocket broadcast hooks for the Mattermost server, handling events like mentions, followers, permalink previews, burn-on-read, and reactions. It includes hook registration, processing logic, permission checks, and utility functions.

classes.name: addMentionsBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing mention broadcasts, adding mention info if user is mentioned.

classes.name: addFollowersBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing followers broadcasts, adding follower info if user is a follower.

classes.name: postedAckBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing post acknowledgment, determining if a post should be acknowledged based on mentions or followers.

classes.name: permalinkBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for processing permalink previews, adding permalink metadata if user has access.

classes.name: channelMentionsBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for filtering channel mentions based on user permissions.

classes.name: burnOnReadBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for handling burn-on-read posts, removing post content after being read.

classes.name: burnOnReadReactionBroadcastHook
classes.description: Hook for handling reactions with burn-on-read, checking read receipts.

methods.name: makeBroadcastHooks
methods.description: Creates a map of broadcast hook names to hook instances.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes the WebSocket event for various hooks, e.g., mentions, followers, permalink, burn-on-read, reactions.

methods.name: useAddMentionsHook
methods.description: Adds mention data to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: useAddFollowersHook
methods.description: Adds followers data to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: usePostedAckHook
methods.description: Adds acknowledgment info to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: usePermalinkHook
methods.description: Adds permalink preview data to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: useBurnOnReadHook
methods.description: Adds burn-on-read post data to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: useBurnOnReadReactionHook
methods.description: Adds burn-on-read reaction data to a WebSocket event.

methods.name: getPostFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts and unmarshals the post from a WebSocket message.

methods.name: getTypedArg
methods.description: Retrieves and correctly types hook arguments, re-encoding/decoding as needed.
